dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Prominent and sharp-edged pale buff margins contrasting against dark brown feather bodies on the folded primaries and secondaries.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Distinct transition boundary where the uniform brown plumage of the crown meets the high-contrast scalloped pattern of the mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly visible pale buff auricular patch situated behind the eye.
